name: 40-retry-triage
note: A batch that overran `llm.max_tokens` recorded every post in it as MODEL_ERROR: the evidence was collected and paid for, only the judgement is missing. This re-judges exactly those posts in a NEW iteration that carries `retry_of_iteration_id`, inherits the parent's `anchor_at` so the correlation window does not slide off the evidence it exists to complete, and does not re-collect. The parent is never edited — both records stand as what each run did.
